incidents.name: DAO Maker vesting unprotected init()
incidents.notes: The vesting contract's init() carried no access control or initialized guard, so the attacker re-initialized it with themselves as the sole beneficiary and then called emergencyExit() to sweep the deposited sale tokens.

sources.ref: onchain review: attack tx calls 0x2fd602ed directly with selector 0x84304ad7 (init); contract created 2021-08-03 by 0xcf28556ee95be8c52ad2f3480149128cca51dac1, not by attack sender 0x2708cace; note this is the 2021-09-03 DAO Maker incident, distinct from the 2021-08-12 one. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): the vesting contract's 45-byte runtime is an EIP-1167 minimal proxy (363d3d373d3d3d363d73) whose master 0xf17ca0e0f24a5fa27944275fa0cedec24fbf8ee2 is baked into the bytecode and is the only address delegatecalled in the exploit (selector 0x84304ad7, init); keccak(eth_getCode) is identical at the creation block 12951447 and the incident block 13155321, so the delegatecall target cannot be repointed.
